presets.name: Drowned Tines
presets.desc: Tine piano with highs and lows cut, slow tape wobble and a dark halo. Two-chord beds.

presets.name: Half-Speed Keys
presets.desc: Keys printed to tape at 0.85x: slower wobble, darker top. Sits with slowed tracks.

presets.name: Hushed Felt Grand
presets.desc: Soft, close felt piano with the top rolled off. Ballads and slow trap-soul.

presets.name: Syrup Tine
presets.desc: Warm, barky tine piano with chorus and light drive. Neo-soul comping.

presets.name: Dusk Poly Chords
presets.desc: Saw plus pulse plus sub with thick chorus. Chord stabs or held beds.

presets.name: Pump Saw Stab
presets.desc: Wide supersaw stab with a snappy filter, ducking to the beat. House chords.

presets.name: Chorus Jangle Clean
presets.desc: Clean single-coil style guitar through soft chorus and a plate. Bedroom-pop jangle.

presets.name: Five-Take Steel Acoustic
presets.desc: Picked steel-string guitar spread wide, open strings ringing. Verse to big chorus.

presets.name: Porch Nylon
presets.desc: Warm nylon pluck with a woody body. Sad-trap loops and Latin ostinatos.

presets.name: Spring Surf Strum
presets.desc: Bright, slightly driven guitar for fast surf punk and bedroom indie.

presets.name: Night Celesta
presets.desc: Glassy celesta, bright but small. Sparse high arpeggios above the vocal.

presets.name: Boogie Keytar
presets.desc: Saw-plus-pulse lead with a snappy filter. Boogie answer phrases.

presets.name: Bubble Reed Call
presets.desc: Breathy sax-like call soaked in ping-pong echo.

presets.name: Velvet Swell Strings
presets.desc: Ensemble saw strings with a slow swell, delayed vibrato and a soft top.

presets.name: Wonky Analog Poly
presets.desc: Slightly out-of-tune, heavily chorused brassy poly that ducks to the beat.

presets.name: Angel Stretch Cloud
presets.desc: Stretched, floating 'ooh-ah' cloud. In cloud rap it is the lead instrument.

presets.name: Voice-Memo Chop
presets.desc: Short pitched 'ah' chop. Play it like a lead for house hooks.

presets.name: Long Glide 808
presets.desc: Clean, long sine 808 with a short pitch thump and soft drive.

presets.name: Disco Pulse Bass
presets.desc: Busy plucky bass with a short filter snap. Disco, boogie and house.

presets.name: Phone 808
presets.desc: Saturated, slightly crushed 808 that reads on small speakers. Plugg and lo-fi.

presets.name: Dotted Echo Arp
presets.desc: Clean guitar arp multiplied by a dotted-eighth echo into a cascade.

presets.name: Night Pluck Arp
presets.desc: Hollow square pluck for 1/16 arpeggios in melodic house.

presets.name: Round Walking Sub
presets.desc: Round sine-plus-harmonic sub that follows the roots. Afrobeats, cumbia, bedroom pop.

presets.name: Wood Bass Pluck
presets.desc: Woody plucked low string: a thump, then a soft decay. Upright or fingered bass.

presets.name: Cloud FM Bell
presets.desc: FM bell at a 3.5 ratio with light digital grain. Cloud-rap motifs.

presets.name: Bakelite Upright
presets.desc: A piano heard through an old radio: narrow band, mono, wow.

presets.name: Lounge Drawbar Organ
presets.desc: Soft soul drawbar organ with vibrato and gentle drive. Pumping stabs.

presets.name: Wobble Reed Keys
presets.desc: Reed piano with bite, tape wow and a dull top. Bedroom-pop and soft-rock chords.

presets.name: Brass Sigh Lead
presets.desc: Soft trumpet-like brass with a slow swell and delayed vibrato. Counter-melodies.

presets.name: Fat Mono Line
presets.desc: Fat two-saw mono line with resonant bite. Counter-melodies and bass doubles.

presets.name: Formant Night Pad
presets.desc: Breathy pad whose vowels morph over time. Ethereal beds.

presets.name: Ghost Swarm Bed
presets.desc: Dark drifting additive bed with airy noise. Two-chord drones.

presets.name: Shoegaze Haze Wall
presets.desc: Driven, detuned saw wall standing in for fuzzed guitars, long dark tails.

presets.name: Frozen Halo
presets.desc: Wordless choir wash that hangs in place between vocal phrases.

presets.name: L/C/R Ooh Choir
presets.desc: Stacked soft 'ooh' choir, triple-tracked wide. Intros and hooks.

presets.name: Reverse Ghost Chop
presets.desc: Reversed vocal swells for transitions and circular motifs.

presets.name: Garage Reese Floor
presets.desc: Detuned saw reese over a sine with a slow warble. Garage drops.

presets.name: Tropic Mallet
presets.desc: Soft-mallet marimba for tropical ostinatos and answer phrases.

presets.name: Cassette Hiss Bed
presets.desc: Pitched tape hiss and breath that glues bedroom tracks together.

presets.name: Feedback Drone
presets.desc: Beating tuned drone in the style of amp feedback. Swells under a section turn.

presets.name: Warehouse Stab Piano
presets.desc: Bright, hard-hammered piano for 90s house chord stabs.

presets.name: Club Organ Stab
presets.desc: Hollow, punchy organ for house bass-lines and chord stabs.

presets.name: Ensemble Poly Six
presets.desc: Six-voice analog poly with a thick ensemble chorus. Chords that glow.

presets.name: Glassline Poly
presets.desc: Modern analog poly pluck with a glassy pulse edge.

presets.name: Twin Filter Scream
presets.desc: Screaming high-pass plus low-pass lead with resonant bite.

presets.name: Ladder Mono Bass
presets.desc: Three-oscillator ladder bass with a punchy filter snap.

presets.name: Ladder Lead
presets.desc: Fat ladder-filter solo lead with delayed vibrato.

presets.name: Brass Memory Poly
presets.desc: Big analog poly brass with a swelling filter.

presets.name: Prepared Bolt Piano
presets.desc: Piano with bolts and paper on the strings: metal partials and a buzz.

presets.name: Toy Box Piano
presets.desc: Tiny struck rods, a little out of tune. Nursery and lo-fi motifs.

presets.name: Saloon Tack Piano
presets.desc: Detuned strings and tacks on the hammers. Saloon and ragtime colour.

presets.name: Leaning Upright
presets.desc: An old upright nobody tunes, recorded to tape. Warm and wonky.

presets.name: Stage Electric Grand
presets.desc: Thin, bright stage piano with pickup shimmer. 80s ballads.

presets.name: Sticky Reed Keys
presets.desc: Short plucked reeds with a sticky attack. 60s pop keys.

presets.name: Funk Pick Clav
presets.desc: Bright plucked-string keys for tight funk rhythm parts.

presets.name: Tape Strip Strings
presets.desc: Strings on 8-second tape strips: wobble, hiss, and they run out.

presets.name: Tape Strip Flute
presets.desc: Breathy flute on a worn tape strip. Psych intros.

presets.name: Optical Disc Organ
presets.desc: Home organ read off a scratched optical disc. Crackle and wow.

presets.name: Digital Glass EP
presets.desc: Glassy digital FM electric piano with a bright tine ping. 80s ballads.

presets.name: Night Drive Keys
presets.desc: Low-passed tine keys with tape wobble and a dark room. Slow late-night chords.

presets.name: Velvet Tines
presets.desc: Clean, round electric piano with a gentle chorus. Neo-soul voicings.

presets.name: Submerged Felt
presets.desc: Felt piano heard through a wall: muffled hammers, warm wobble, long tail.

presets.name: Moonlit Upright
presets.desc: Soft upright with a little detune between strings. Honest and close.

presets.name: Perreo Keys
presets.desc: Bright, barky stab keys that sit on a dembow groove. Pump locked to the beat.

presets.name: Glass Room EP
presets.desc: Tine piano with the bell partial pushed forward, wide and glassy.

presets.name: Tape Organ
presets.desc: Soft drawbar organ printed to a worn tape. Sustains forever.

presets.name: Hazy Reed Keys
presets.desc: Reed electric piano with bite on the attack, then a hazy low-passed body.

presets.name: Submerged Choir
presets.desc: Ghost choir under water. Hold one chord and let it breathe.

presets.name: Midnight Wash
presets.desc: Wide detuned wash, low-passed until it is almost a memory.

presets.name: Supersaw Bloom
presets.desc: Nine-voice supersaw chords that duck to the beat. Instant drop.

presets.name: Neon Haze
presets.desc: Moody saw-and-pulse atmosphere for perreo intros and bridges.

presets.name: Floating Dream Pad
presets.desc: Soft floaty pad with a slow filter drift and dotted echoes. Melodies float on it.

presets.name: Cold Glass
presets.desc: Glassy additive shimmer with slow beating partials.

presets.name: Analog Dusk
presets.desc: Two-oscillator analog pad, warm and slightly resonant.

presets.name: Velvet Strings
presets.desc: Ensemble strings from detuned saws. Slow swell, soft top end.

presets.name: Static Bloom
presets.desc: Pitched noise blooming into a tone. Texture under anything.

presets.name: Future Pluck
presets.desc: Detuned saw pluck with a snappy filter, pumping on the quarter note.

presets.name: Dembow Nylon
presets.desc: Nylon-string pluck with a woody body. Arpeggios and tresillo riffs.

presets.name: Night Marimba
presets.desc: Soft-mallet marimba with a night-time reverb. Tropical melodies.

presets.name: Dusty Kalimba
presets.desc: Thumb piano through a dusty tape deck.

presets.name: Vox Chop Pluck
presets.desc: Short synthetic 'ah' chop. Play it like a lead for vocal-chop hooks.

presets.name: Waterlogged Keen
presets.desc: High, soft sine-ish pluck through water. Dotted-eighth echoes for floating hooks.

presets.name: Glint Harp
presets.desc: Bright plucked harp, wide reverb, sparkling echoes.

presets.name: Hyper Saw Lead
presets.desc: Detuned saw lead for drop melodies. Grit and pump already dialled in.

presets.name: Velvet Square
presets.desc: Rounded square lead, soft and vocal. Hooks over a dembow.

presets.name: Hollow Flute
presets.desc: Breathy synthetic flute with delayed vibrato.

presets.name: Siren Vox Lead
presets.desc: Wordless synthetic voice with a singer's vibrato.

presets.name: Dirty Brass Lead
presets.desc: Low, fuzzy synth brass: dirty, nothing bright. Heavy reggaeton riffs.

presets.name: Grit Saw Lead
presets.desc: Driven saw lead with teeth. Cuts through a busy drop.

presets.name: Crystal FM Bell
presets.desc: Two-operator FM bell, glassy attack and a long shimmering tail.

presets.name: Music Box Memory
presets.desc: Tiny music box with a warped tape memory.

presets.name: Celeste Mist
presets.desc: Celeste under water. Pairs with low-passed keys.

presets.name: Gamelan Glass
presets.desc: Inharmonic metal bars that beat against each other.

presets.name: Ooh Ensemble
presets.desc: Six synthetic singers on an 'ooh'. Big, soft background vocals.

presets.name: Ah Chop Stack
presets.desc: Stacked 'ah' chops for call-and-response hooks.

presets.name: Breath Vox
presets.desc: A pitched whisper. Doubles a topline without getting in the way.

presets.name: Formant Swirl
presets.desc: Vowels morphing a-o-e-u while you hold the note.

presets.name: Long 808
presets.desc: Clean, long 808 with a short pitch drop. Glue for every low end.

presets.name: Grit 808
presets.desc: Saturated 808 that reads on phone speakers.

presets.name: Punch 808
presets.desc: Short, punchy 808 for bouncing dembow bass lines.

presets.name: Reese Shadow
presets.desc: Detuned saw reese with a sine underneath. Dark and moving.

presets.name: Degraded Floor Bass
presets.desc: Saw plus sine bass crushed to a 4.4 kHz sample rate. Dark, grainy floor.

presets.name: Round Sub
presets.desc: Pure sustained sub. Sits under keys without clouding them.

presets.name: Dembow Bass
presets.desc: Round plucky bass for tight reggaeton lines.

presets.name: Low End Chop
presets.desc: Tine comping printed through a 25 kHz sampler with a steep, resonance-free filter. Sweep TONE from 250 Hz for the bassline up to the full chop.

presets.name: Rainy Tine Keys
presets.desc: Soft tine piano sampled at 32 kHz with a slow 0.5 Hz wobble. Ninths and sus chords at 56-60% swing.

presets.name: Basement Drop Piano
presets.desc: Piano played an octave up and dropped 12 semitones by resampling: slow hammers, dark top, long tails. Sparse minor seconds and tritones.

presets.name: Glass Ballad Tines
presets.desc: Digital FM electric piano: 1:1 body with a 14:1 tinkle on the attack. Soft playing stays round, hard playing turns clangy.

presets.name: Bark Stage Tines
presets.desc: Stage tine piano with a low-mid bump and amp drive: round when soft, barking when you dig in.

presets.name: Reed Bite Keys
presets.desc: Steel-reed electric piano that breaks into bite on hard hits. Bedroom R&B chords at the writing desk.

presets.name: Clank House Piano
presets.desc: Bright hard-hammer piano band-limited to 32 kHz and stretched 3 semitones per zone, on purpose. Offbeat sevenths and minor-ninth stabs.

presets.name: Barrio Sheen Pluck
presets.desc: Brittle saw-and-pulse digital pluck with a fast filter snap. Minor i-VI-III-VII as 16th broken chords at 90-98 BPM.

presets.name: Steel Lotus
presets.desc: Hand-struck steel tone fields tuned 1:2:3 with a faint fifth halo. Built for D minor.

presets.name: Sierra Lead Runs
presets.desc: Small nylon six-string tuned a fourth above guitar, picked close to the bridge. Triplet runs in harmonic minor over half-time hats.

presets.name: Highland Ten-String
presets.desc: Bright paired-course plucks in the small Andean ten-string's range, one zone per semitone. Fast 16th strums on the 'and'.

presets.name: Optical Lullaby Guitar
presets.desc: Nylon guitar read off an optical disc: 150 Hz to 5 kHz, wow and flutter, hard on and off. Slow lullaby arpeggios.

presets.name: Seven Sun Saw
presets.desc: Seven free-running saws with a measured centre-heavy detune, printed mono with a thin bottom. Wide only through the FX.

presets.name: Anthem Brass Stab
presets.desc: Fat workstation-style synth brass: quick filter bite, octave-down weight, a forward 1 kHz horn band. Anthem stabs.

presets.name: Smoked Horn Section
presets.desc: Low synth horn section printed through a dark clip: dirty, nothing bright. Off-beat minor stabs over a dembow.

presets.name: Far Apart Duo
presets.desc: A filtered saw on the left and a thin pulse on the right, a few cents apart. Two elements, far apart.

presets.name: Rain Neon Brass
presets.desc: Two-layer analog brass that swells open under your touch and falls off the ribbon. Rain-soaked city chords.

presets.name: Kaleido Sweep Poly
presets.desc: One stable oscillator per voice, a darkened saw printed dry so a phaser and chorus can swirl it. Psych-pop beds.

presets.name: Hillside Lament
presets.desc: Cheap, grainy phone-ROM strings in a big hall. Minor chords held for bars, an empty bar before the drop.

presets.name: Coastline Chorus Pad
presets.desc: Steady one-oscillator pad with a sub an octave down and a breath of noise, printed dry for a slow stereo chorus.

presets.name: Mono Memory Pad
presets.desc: A wide unison pad collapsed to mono and glued on tape. Narrow, close and instantly nostalgic.

presets.name: First Light Bellpad
presets.desc: A struck glassy attack over a warm sustained body, bell partials fading into the pad. Late-80s digital dawn.

presets.name: Cruise Whistle Lead
presets.desc: High, near-sine whine with a touch of second harmonic that brightens when you dig in. Mod wheel for vibrato. West-coast leads.

presets.name: Tinnitus Siren
presets.desc: Piercing pure tone doubled 7 cents sharp so it beats like ringing ears. Play it high and keep it quiet.

presets.name: Broken Platter Cumbia
presets.desc: Three wet-tuned reeds played off a turntable running slow: deeper, darker and watery. Sonidero melodies.

presets.name: Altiplano Breath
presets.desc: Dark, breathy notched-flute tone with a chiff on every note and a live singer's vibrato. Andean minor phrases.

presets.name: Wet Rim Seraph
presets.desc: Rubbed glass rims: a near-pure tone that swells in under a faint 5 Hz shimmer. Slow legato, two notes at most.

presets.name: Ribbon Wraith
presets.desc: A soft, peak-limited sine that glides on a 12-semitone bend and sings with the mod wheel. Haunted film lines.

presets.name: Hillside Lament Horn
presets.desc: Mournful phone-ROM horn with a late vibrato. Answers the strings in two or three notes.

presets.name: Molasses Glide Sub
presets.desc: Long-decay kick played as a bassline: a quick strike chirp, a small sigh, then a sustained sine with bite.

presets.name: Paredao Pressure
presets.desc: Hard-clipped 808 with a two-octave dive and a pushed 110 Hz bump for car walls and phone speakers.

presets.name: Lowland Growl Bass
presets.desc: Three-oscillator ladder bass overdriven back into itself: a fast filter snap, then a fat growl.

presets.name: Warehouse Click Organ
presets.desc: Hollow organ bass with a clicky third harmonic that dies away fast. Octave-jumping off-beat house lines.

presets.name: Wet Wire Squelch
presets.desc: Bare saw with a fixed decay into a live resonant ladder whose envelope snaps shut. Ride the cutoff.

presets.name: Haunted Music Box
presets.desc: Hollow FM music-box bell: odd partials, an octave sparkle and a dark top. Minor-key trap motifs over a choir bed.

presets.name: Iron Tonk Bell
presets.desc: Two clanging pulse tones about a flat fifth apart through a band-pass, with a fast two-stage decay. Push GRIT for drift-phonk cowbell leads.

presets.name: Pixel Bell FM
presets.desc: Bright 1:1 FM bell-pluck with a glassy high tine that settles to a soft held tone. Plugg melodies with ping-pong echo.

presets.name: Eight Hertz Bronze
presets.desc: Bronze bars struck in tuned pairs that beat against each other, about 8 Hz in the middle register. Shimmering interlocking figures.

presets.name: Helium Soul Chop
presets.desc: Small bright soul-singer stack with thin lows, a lifted top and an 11 kHz ceiling. Sped-up soul hooks.

presets.name: Stamp and Stutter
presets.desc: Dry, phone-band shouted syllable. Retrigger it in 16ths with a little GRIT for funk stamps and stutters.

presets.name: Eight-Second Seraphs
presets.desc: Eight-voice 'aah' on worn tape strips: soft start, wow, hiss, and every note runs out at eight seconds.

presets.name: Halo Smear Choir
presets.desc: Breathy stacked 'ah' choir pitched down four semitones on tape with a grainy stretch flutter. Angelic cloud-rap beds.

presets.name: Hiccup Honeycomb
presets.desc: Tiny vowel-gliding syllable, tape-glued and short. Play it like a drum for 2-step vocal hiccups.
